name: branding-eight-petal-gem-logo-in-rainbow-gradient-facets
title: An eight-facet gem-petal logo in blue, pink, orange and green gradients above a bold 'Lorem Ipsum' wordmark
whatItIs: A symmetrical mark made of eight faceted diamond 'petals' arranged in a ring around empty centre space, each facet gradient-shaded in a different hue (blue, pink, orange, green), sitting above a bold black 'LOREM IPSUM' wordmark and a thin 'SLOGAN HERE' tagline.
whatItMeans: Vibrant and premium; faceted gradients make a simple geometric ring feel jewel-like and dynamic.
techniques: Arrange faceted shapes symmetrically around a negative-space centre.
Gradient-shade each facet a different hue for vibrancy.
Pair a colourful mark with a plain black wordmark for balance.

vocabulary.definition: A flat angled surface, as if cut like a gemstone.
The empty area within or around a shape that is part of the design.
